environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; broad leaves with visible but soft ribbing; tactile, leathery surfaces with subtle specular highlights to suggest humidity; rounded, appealing tips.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-range shot focusing on a cluster of broad, palm-like leaves overhanging a still, dark pool of water. The leaves catch the light reflecting off the water's surface.
visual_logic.ground: Muddy, olive-toned banks with half-submerged decaying leaves and silty shale nodules.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, humid afternoon sun filtered through mist, creating soft-edged shadows across the broad fronds.
